title: Student-Curriculum Coupling for temporal video grounding available on arXiv
html: Congratulations to Jiacheng Qiu, Yunsoo Kim, and our collaborators on their new preprint! Their student-curriculum coupling approach improves temporal video grounding with fewer training examples. [PDF]

title: SCOPE available on arXiv
html: As first author, I am pleased to share SCOPE, a single-pass approach to recovering full PDE fields from sparse observations. [PDF] [Code]

title: PDE-OBS available on arXiv
html: I led PDE-OBS as first author; the new preprint benchmarks PDE models across changing observation patterns. [PDF] [Code]

title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting accepted at TMLR with minor revision
html: Congratulations to Haochun Wang and the team on their TMLR acceptance with minor revision! Their time-series forecasting paper studies principled test-time adaptation. [arXiv]

title: ICLR 2027 reviewer invitation accepted
html: Accepted the invitation to serve as a reviewer for ICLR 2027.

title: HP-JEPA available on arXiv
html: My first-author paper HP-JEPA is now on arXiv. It learns predictive graph representations across multiple resolutions. [PDF]

title: TMLR reviewer
html: Serving as a reviewer for Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR).

title: REU Research Mentor at AI3
html: Mentored AI4Science projects in the AI3 REU program at Stony Brook University.

title: Generative backmapping published in CPC
html: Congratulations to Georgios Kementzidis and collaborators on their Computer Physics Communications publication! Their multistep generative backmapping method restores atomistic detail from coarse-grained structures.

title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting — arXiv preprint
html: Congratulations to Haochun Wang and colleagues on sharing their preprint! Their test-time adaptation study calibrates time-series forecasts without retraining the underlying model. [PDF]

title: ICML 2026 Gold Reviewer
html: Recognized as a Gold Reviewer at ICML 2026 for the quality of submitted reviews.

title: GAGA accepted to ICLR 2026
html: Congratulations to Jingxiang Qu, Wenhan Gao, and their coauthors on ICLR 2026! Their GAGA paper makes 3D molecular generation more efficient through Gaussianity-aware approximation. [arXiv]

title: Instructor for AMS 361
html: Taught AMS 361: Applied Calculus IV at Stony Brook University.

title: Can Data-Driven Dynamics Reveal Hidden Physics? There Is A Need for Interpretable Neural Operators — arXiv preprint
html: Congratulations to Wenhan Gao and the research team on their arXiv preprint! They ask whether interpretable neural operators can reveal hidden physical dynamics. [PDF]

title: Three papers at NYSDS 2025
html: Three papers were accepted to NYSDS 2025 (one oral, two posters). I am first author of the Hamiltonian learning paper and co-corresponding author of the boundary-informed PINN and physics-informed active-learning papers. [arXiv]

title: RL-QESA at AI for Math @ ICML
html: I presented my first-author RL-QESA work as a poster at AI for Math @ ICML 2025, exploring reinforcement-learned cooling policies for simulated annealing.

title: APOD at the ICML Assessing World Models Workshop
html: Our first-author APOD paper was accepted to the Assessing World Models Workshop @ ICML 2025; it uses observations and PDE constraints to guide diffusion sampling.

title: Dynamic Schwartz-Fourier Neural Operator in TMLR
html: Congratulations to Wenhan Gao, Jian Luo, and colleagues on their TMLR publication! Their Dynamic Schwartz–Fourier Neural Operator uses input-dependent Fourier kernels for greater expressive power.

title: Velocity-Inferred Hamiltonian Neural Networks: Learning Energy-Conserving Dynamics from Position-Only Data — arXiv preprint
html: I am first author of the new velocity-inferred Hamiltonian networks preprint, which learns energy-conserving dynamics from position-only observations. [PDF]

title: KAR for symplectic learning at IJCNN
html: As co-first author and project lead, I am glad to share the IJCNN 2025 acceptance of Kolmogorov–Arnold Representation for Symplectic Learning. [arXiv]

title: The Impact of Move Schemes on Simulated Annealing Performance — arXiv preprint
html: My first-author preprint on move schemes in simulated annealing is available on arXiv, examining how the number of coordinates updated per move affects optimization. [PDF]

title: Neural-operator discretization mismatch at ICLR
html: Congratulations to Wenhan Gao and collaborators on their ICLR 2025 paper! Their study of discretization mismatch probes how neural operators behave when the grid changes.

title: Coordinate Transform FNO in TMLR
html: Congratulations to Wenhan Gao and his coauthors on their TMLR publication! Their Coordinate Transform Fourier Neural Operators incorporate physical symmetries through coordinate transformations.
